## 正文

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Dev Engineer Review

`UploadLogPlugin` now retries spool setup and append operations after `FileNotFoundError`. If spool initialization, report processing, or finalization raises `OSError`, it disables spooling and preserves native pytest captures. Cleanup no longer attempts to remove the spool root’s parent.

The tests cover selected spool failure paths, but do not establish behavior for every `OSError` type. Review findings and test execution results were not supplied.

## QA Engineer Review

The PR modifies `tests/unittest/test_s3_output.py` and adds it to `tests/integration/test_lists/test-db/l0_cpu.yml`. New tests cover retries when spool directories disappear, continued capture when spool setup or append fails, and warning details. Existing cleanup assertions now expect an empty spool root. Coverage verdict: **sufficient** for the described failure paths. Test execution status is unavailable.

## Per-File QA Perspective

- `tests/test_common/s3_output.py`: Verify spool retries, disabled-spooling behavior, preserved native captures, and cleanup after successful uploads.
- `tests/unittest/test_s3_output.py`: Adds tests for directory-disappearance retries and spool failures; updates cleanup assertions. The test file is listed in `tests/integration/test_lists/test-db/l0_cpu.yml`.
- `tests/integration/test_lists/test-db/l0_cpu.yml`: Adds `unittest/test_s3_output.py` to the CPU CI test list.

|**Report hooks and spool cleanup** <br> `tests/test_common/s3_output.py`, `tests/unittest/test_s3_output.py`|Report and session hooks skip spool-dependent work after spooling becomes unavailable and disable spooling after filesystem errors.
